scripts.lint:js: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.lint:php: composer --working-dir=auth lint && composer --working-dir=catalog lint && composer --working-dir=notification lint && composer --working-dir=order lint && composer --working-dir=order lint && composer --working-dir=analytics lint && composer --working-dir=recommendation lint
scripts.lint:go: docker run --rm -v $PWD/search:/src -v go-mod-cache:/go/pkg/mod -w /src golang:1.24 sh -c 'test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./...'
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php && npm run lint:go
scripts.test:go: docker run --rm -v $PWD/search:/src -v go-mod-cache:/go/pkg/mod -w /src golang:1.24 go test ./...
scripts.test:all: composer --working-dir=auth test && composer --working-dir=catalog test && composer --working-dir=notification test && composer --working-dir=order test && composer --working-dir=analytics test && composer --working-dir=recommendation test && npm run test:go
